title: Bitcoin execution plan
verdict_reason: No validated strategy at all. Phase 1 (M5 RSI pullback) failed cold OOS at PF 0.75 and Phase 1c (H1 Donchian) failed at PF 0.96, so the running book is an observation feed: 141 closed / PF 0.846 at 2026-10-28. Those trades are not evidence for any successor.
summary: Nothing unblocks until a NEW hypothesis passes its own cold-OOS gate on bars nobody has inspected. Every parameter in btc/config.py is still a gold-derived placeholder.
never: Never change TRADING_MODE, the BTC service units, or MAX_SPREAD_POINTS without an explicit user decision in this session.
Never set BTC_STRATEGY=donchian: Phase 1c failed (cold OOS -$40.03, PF 0.96) and the plumbing existing is not evidence.
Never treat proxy (Binance) or exchange CSVs as BTC evidence; the gate reads XM bars only.
Never re-pull or re-rank on the inspected windows, or reuse data/BTCUSD_H1.csv (sha256 f7305461...ab21).
Never count the current paper book toward a successor's evidence, or re-tune the RSI-pullback / Donchian shape on overlapping data.
Never add a second WEEKEND_FLAT_ENABLED assignment to btc/config.py; that exact duplication ran the wrong rule for a day.
Never flip to LIVE on the shared XM account: portfolio.py caps the pair at $38/day and gold's own $30 can consume most of it.

phases.title: Pre-register a new BTC hypothesis on untouched bars
phases.goal: Produce a dated pre-registration whose TRAIN/OOS split uses timestamps that have never been inspected.
steps: Write the hypothesis, the parameter grid (bounded), the selection statistic and the exact exit rule into one dated doc.
Pull fresh XM bars through btc/recon.py and record the sha256 and the TRAIN/OOS boundaries in the doc BEFORE any sweep.
State the gate in advance: net > 0, PF >= 1.2, n >= 60 cold OOS, gross > cost, and one look at OOS only.
Record the pre-registration in the STATUS changelog and in plans/btc.json (this file).
phases.exit_gate: A committed pre-registration with fresh hashes and boundaries, and no result inspected yet.
commands: mt5env/bin/python btc/recon.py --bars 20000   # read-only pull + contract spec; safe while gold trades
phases.evidence: The dated pre-registration doc with hashes, plus the STATUS row.

phases.title: Train-select once, freeze, cold OOS
phases.goal: Accept or reject the new shape on its own reserved window.
steps: Screen on TRAIN only with btc/edge_screen.py, select by the pre-registered statistic, freeze the winner.
Run btc/train_select.py for the cold-OOS confirmation. One look; no re-selection.
Write the dated result. On failure, close it and pre-register a new hypothesis, not a new split of the same bars.
phases.exit_gate: A dated result report with net > 0, PF >= 1.2, n >= 60 and gross > cost, or an explicit close.
phases.evidence: The dated report and the STATUS decision row.

phases.title: Derive BTC parameters instead of inheriting gold's
phases.goal: Replace every PLACEHOLDER in btc/config.py with a value derived from BTC data, with provenance.
steps: Derive ATR_MIN from the BTC ATR distribution (a 10-20th percentile) or leave 0.0 and say so honestly.
Re-derive MAX_SPREAD_POINTS with the 1.25x TRAIN p90 rule from the same file the strategy was validated on.
Size MAX_DAILY_LOSS and MAX_TRADES_PER_DAY from the passing strategy's own trade distribution (0.01 lots risks ~$1-3 per BTC stop).
Record the quantile -> file -> date provenance next to each value in btc/config.py.
phases.exit_gate: A reviewed parameter table with provenance, committed together with the doc that justifies it.
phases.evidence: The provenance comment block plus the config diff reviewed as a deployment decision.

phases.title: Broker recon: symbol spec, swap and the server offset
phases.window: parallel; independent of the strategy outcome
phases.goal: Learn what a BTC trade actually costs and when the broker is closed or charging financing.
steps: Confirm symbol name, digits, contract size, stops level, filling mode and volume limits with btc/recon.py.
Record swap_long / swap_short and the Friday triple-swap day; the engine models no swap P&L at all.
Pin the server's UTC offset, then decide on ENTRY_BLACKOUTS_ENABLED (rollover and Saturday maintenance) and record the decision.
Revisit WEEKEND_FLAT_ENABLED = False in writing: it is a risk judgement (2026-10-24), not a measured BTC result.
phases.exit_gate: A recon report with the offset and swap values in it, plus an explicit blackout/weekend decision.
commands: mt5env/bin/python btc/recon.py --self-test   # offline sanity, no bridge
mt5env/bin/python btc/preflight.py           # would the spread gate let it trade?
phases.evidence: The filled spec table and the decided offset.

phases.title: Demo execution drill, BTC-specific
phases.goal: Prove execution on this broker for an instrument whose stop is ~$275 of price.
steps: Run the same 20-trade 0.01-lot demo drill as gold: requested vs filled, attached SL, one BE round-trip.
Sample spread in thin hours and during the Saturday maintenance window; hold one position through a rollover and record the swap actually charged.
Verify minimum stop distance and the margin a 2xATR stop implies at 0.01 lots.
Only BTC_STRATEGY=donchian is refused in code outside FORWARD_TEST; every other BTC LIVE block is documentary, so this drill is the barrier.
phases.exit_gate: A demo execution report plus a pre-agreed realized-R tolerance.
phases.evidence: The filled-trade table including the swap charge.

phases.title: Separate account or a hard combined risk gate
phases.goal: Stop a BTC pilot from trading on the residual of gold's risk budget.
steps: Decide explicitly: a separate BTC account, or one combined gate that is tested rather than assumed.
If combined: write a test that proves the cap binds across both books, then land it.
Agree the pilot funding and loss limit; $300 of paper balance is not live capital.
phases.exit_gate: A signed account-risk decision plus the test that enforces it.
commands: python3 -m pytest tests/ -q   # or the smoke gate
phases.evidence: The decision doc and the enforcing test.

phases.title: A forward cohort that starts at zero
phases.goal: Measure the frozen BTC engine, with nothing carried over from the failed shape.
steps: Freeze the strategy and exit engine; a material change starts a NEW cohort.
Review weekly on mean R with a bootstrap CI, not on trade count.
Signal supply is not the constraint (141 trades in three weeks); edge is.
phases.exit_gate: A powered positive cohort on the frozen engine.
